title: Global sections of internal condensed coefficient modules with scalars forgotten
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $X$ be a scheme with small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and put $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. On internal $\Lambda_X$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], define the abelian-group-valued global sections functor $\Gamma_{\Lambda,X}:\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}(\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathbf{Ab}))\to\mathbf{Ab}$ by forgetting the module action and evaluating the underlying abelian sheaf at the final object $\operatorname{id}_X:X\to X$. Thus $\Gamma_{\Lambda,X}(M)=M(X)$ as an abelian group and $\Gamma_{\Lambda,X}(a)=a_X$ on morphisms. No commutativity, completeness, affineness, or finiteness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Section 3, coefficient modules and global sections convention; proof of Lemma 5.3(1), global sections with coefficient action forgotten.
